method.measure: Runner per-fixture elapsed milliseconds: package preparation, compile/check routes and native execution; excludes Rust build time.
method.scaling: Temporarily change Cell array capacity and its position bound to 8 or 32. Extend the reference array to 8 or 32 elements, retaining first/second at indices 0/1 and repeating &main.first in the rest. Restore both original fixtures afterward.

observations: Sampled compile stacks include structural contract resolution and named-value type lookup; they do not establish a particular superlinear custody join.
The probe retains two distinct reference roots, so increasing carrier count does not test increasing distinct-owner count.
The historical 3.3s-to-9s numbers came from Linux corpus waves and were not reproduced as a same-host revision comparison here.

discovered_defect.cause: The call-free physical body allocates x30 to MaterializeI64(0), while frame planning retains LiveLinkRegister because it only considers calls and forced-save policy.
discovered_defect.repair: Derive saved continuation custody from actual physical unit definitions and clobbers as well as calls. Native macOS ARM64 exit70 after repair.
discovered_defect.performance_claim: None: a rejected compile is not comparable to successful native execution.
